title: Access-request durations in days
spec: Implement parse_duration(text: str) -> int | None: turn a free-text duration from an Acme access request into whole days.
- '<n> <unit>' where unit is day/days (1), week/weeks (7) or month/months (30), and n is a whole number or a decimal with a dot.
- n may also be a word: 'a' or 'an' or 'one' = 1, 'two' = 2, 'three' = 3.
- Fractions round UP to a whole day: '2.5 days' -> 3.
- Upper/lower case and extra spaces or tabs around or between the words do not matter.
- A zero duration, or anything else (empty text, 'soon', 'until the project ends') -> None. Never raise an exception.
